<cat>gameevent</cat>
<title>hltv_title</title>

<structure>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<description>
			Called when the SourceTV client is spawned.
	</description>
	<fields>
		<item type="string" name="text">The SourceTV Name.</item>
	</fields>
</structure>

# Examples
<example>
	<description>This is a basic template with the purpose of including all arguments / table variables to make it easily known which values can be accessed.</description>
	<code>
gameevent.Listen( "hltv_title" )
hook.Add( "hltv_title", "hltv_title_example", function( data )
	local text = data.text	-- The SourceTV

	-- Called when the SourceTV client is spawned
	
end )
	</code>
</example>
